adds.title: Supreme Federal Court decision of 15 October 2025 striking down Garanhuns 'gender ideology' law
adds.summary: On 15 October 2025 the Supreme Federal Court struck down Garanhuns, Pernambuco's municipal law prohibiting teaching about gender, thereby lifting the ban on gender-related instruction in local schools.

adds.title: Lawsuits by Prosecutor General of the Republic and Socialism and Liberty Party against Garanhuns law
adds.summary: In actions brought by the Prosecutor General of the Republic and the Socialism and Liberty Party, Brazil's Supreme Federal Court struck down the Garanhuns municipal law that prohibited teaching about gender, ending the local ban on gender-related instruction.

adds.title: Bill presented June 2026 by state representative João Paulo (PT) on non-discrimination in Unified Health System
adds.summary: In June 2026 Pernambuco state deputy João Paulo (PT) presented Bill No. 4.092/2026 to create the State Policy for Integral Health Promotion of the LGBTQIAPN+ population in the SUS, reinforcing the right to use the social name in registrations and care and respect for gender identities, setting as objectives expanded SUS access with special attention to travestis and transexuais who avoid or delay seeking care for fear of mistreatment plus mental health, violence prevention and vulnerability reduction, and setting as directives combating LGBTphobia and institutional discrimination in health services, continuous training of public health professionals for humanized respectful care, and production, segmentation and publication of LGBT health data and indicators subject to data-protection laws.

adds.title: Piauí Ordinary Law No. 5,916 - Legislative Assembly of Piauí
adds.summary: Piauí Law No. 5,916 enacted 10 November 2009 and published 12 November 2009 guarantees travestis and transexuais the right to identification by nome social on registrations, forms, prontuários and related documents when using services of all direct and indirect state public administration bodies, defines nome social as the name by which they recognize themselves and are recognized socially, requires the social name to appear first and prominently with civil identification below, directs the Executive within 60 days to designate the body responsible for registration and issuance of social-name identification, and retains use of the civil name where public interest or third-party rights require.

adds.title: Court of Justice of Piauí decision - July 20, 2021
adds.summary: On July 20, 2021, the Piauí judiciary granted civil registration as a non-binary person to a young person, the first recognition of a non-binary gender marker in Piauí.
